text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hello, Nanny?
There is something I must ask of you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It seems the skin toner she'd always been using
has been discontinued...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I tried using a substitute, but my skin turned red and started stinging.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"We cannot take rough skin lightly.
...A tiny tear must not be allowed to become a gaping hole, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan seems concerned
about her skin breaking out...
